title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 23
statement: Lakshmi has \(5\) round coins of diameter \(4\) centimeters. She arranges the coins in \(2\) rows on a table top, as shown below, and wraps an elastic band tightly around them. In centimeters, what will be the length of the band?

solutions.text: Trace the path of the centers of the coins. Their convex hull is a trapezoid with bottom side \(8\), top side \(4\), and two slanted sides of length \(4\), so its perimeter is \(20\). Wrapping the band around coins of radius \(2\) adds one full circumference, \(2\pi\cdot2=4\pi\). The band length is \(20+4\pi\).
hints: Trace the path followed by the centers of the coins
Add the center-hull perimeter and one full circumference of radius \(2\)
